notes: Created AURA Audio — a premium planar magnetic headphone brand handcrafted in Portland. The site features: 1) Hero with animated SVG headphone illustration and live stats counter, 2) Three product cards (Aeon $2,499 flagship, Verse $1,799 studio reference, Echo $899 portable) with detailed specs, 3) Technology section explaining 14.2nm diaphragm, N55 magnet arrays, hand-matched pairs, CNC chassis, 4) Six-step manufacturing process timeline, 5) Six detailed testimonials from real-world professionals (mastering engineer, FOH engineer, software engineer, recording engineer, producer, composer) with schema.org Review markup, 6) Press/awards bar, 7) About section with founder story and four core values, 8) Six FAQ entries with honest answers, 9) Full order form with dynamic pricing, validation, 30-day trial consent, and success state — all client-side. Semantic HTML, WCAG AA contrast, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, structured data (Brand, Product, Review), SEO meta tags, responsive 1440px/768px/390px breakpoints. No external dependencies beyond Google Fonts. All SVG illustrations authored inline. Form validates with human-readable errors, shows loading state, generates serial number on success, and allows reset.
